newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sanyo to sell Toshiba-made DVDs from Dec 1.
newsitem.headline: Sanyo to sell Toshiba-made DVDs from Dec 1.

text.p: Sanyo Electric Co Ltd said on Friday it will start selling digital video disc (DVD) players produced by Toshiba Corp from December 1 on the domestic market.
The DVDs sold under the Sanyo brand will cost 77,000 yen, the same as the Toshiba-brand DVD player.
Sanyo, which is not a member of a DVD licencee group, initially plans to have Toshiba produce 1,000 DVD players a month for it, a Sanyo statement said.
Toshiba announced on Thursday that it would launch its DVD player in Japan on November 1.
